text: Northwind Technologies - Leave Policy This policy applies to all full-time employees of Northwind Technologies. Part-time employees receive leave on a pro-rata basis. Annual leave Every full-time employee receives 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave must be requested at least 7 days in advance through the HR portal. Requests for more than 10 consecutive days need approval from the department head. Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried forward to the next year. Carried-forward days expire on 31 March. Sick leave Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave per year. A medical certificate is required if sick leave extends beyond 3 consecutive days. Sick leave cannot be carried forward. Parental leave Primary caregivers are entitled to 16 weeks of paid parental leave. Secondary caregivers are entitled to 4 weeks. Parental leave must begin within 6 months of the child's birth or adoption.

Nimbus Smart Thermostat - Frequently Asked Questions Setup Q: How do I connect the Nimbus thermostat to Wi-Fi? A: Open the Nimbus app, tap Add Device, and follow the prompts. The thermostat only supports 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi networks. 5 GHz networks are not supported. Q: Which wires does the thermostat need? A: It requires a C-wire (common wire). If your system has no C-wire, use the included power adapter kit.

Troubleshooting and warranty Q: How do I factory reset the thermostat? A: Hold the centre dial for 15 seconds until the display shows the word RESET, then release. All schedules and Wi-Fi settings will be erased. Q: What does the flashing red light mean? A: A flashing red light means the battery backup is low. Replace it with a CR2032 battery. Q: What is the warranty period? A: The Nimbus thermostat has a 2-year limited warranty. Damage from incorrect installation is not covered.
